capabilities: , Identify knowledge gaps, audit tags, retrieve context via Graph RAG, draft note updates, execute external tools
intentEvidence: Vault Intelligence is a different AI plugin for Obsidian.
motivation: To transform Obsidian vaults into dynamic, self-maintaining knowledge systems that actively update and maintain structure.
problem: Standard AI plugins treat vaults as static data, failing to maintain consistency, update knowledge, or manage structural connections as the vault grows.
summary: Vault Intelligence is an AI plugin that maintains a vault as a self-updating knowledge system using AI agents, Graph RAG, and live web search.
